text:
maria_finance: FYI OmniData INV-2026-0789 looks like it was billed twice for the same ingestion job. total charged = $24,900, expected = $12,450. requesting a manual credit for $12,450 plus a $500 goodwill credit. can we process?

sam_billing: can you drop the invoice number + short calc here? i'll need it for the journal entry.

maria_finance: INV-2026-0789. reconciliation snippet: `billed_ingest: 2 x 12450 = 24900; expected_ingest: 1 x 12450; discrepancy = 12450; goodwill = 500; total_credit = 12950`

priya_billing_ops: what's the invoice period and did they already pay? if paid we need refund, otherwise we can apply as credit to next invoice.

ken_sales: OmniData already paid on 2026-03-05 and they've asked for refund to clear cashflow concerns. they pushed because this impacted their month-end close.

emma_eng: confirmed - there was a duplicated ingestion job on 2026-02-15 caused by the deploy that retried a job loop. logs attached in the thread (link). root cause fixed.

maria_finance: thanks emma. because they already paid, i'm requesting an immediate refund of $12,950 (12,450 + 500). approval needed from finance director for >$10k. tagging @olivia_fd.

olivia_fd: quick read - looks like product fault and partner impact. approved for immediate refund. please use GL 4021 (Customer Credits - Promo) for the goodwill portion and GL 4050 (Usage Adjustments) for the billed duplication. note JE ref JE-2026-0421. :thumbsup:

sam_billing: copying next steps: 1) create refund RFD-98765 for $12,950 scheduled 2026-03-25, 2) post JE-2026-0421, 3) mark invoice INV-2026-0789 as 'credited/refunded' in billing system, 4) notify customer with confirmation email. i'll take it.

maria_finance: please set memo = "OmniData duplicate ingestion + goodwill" and tag account owner @ken_sales.

billing-bot: Refund RFD-98765 created by sam_billing for $12,950, scheduled payout 2026-03-25. internal ref: PAY-3321.

ken_sales: i'll send the confirmation note to OmniData once the refund is queued. thanks everyone.

priya_billing_ops: i'll reconcile the AR once the refund posts and close the ticket. leaving a note to exclude this from usage-based SLA calculations.

maria_finance: closing loop here. recording action items in the ticketing system and tagging JE-2026-0421 for month-end.

sam_billing: done - invoice status updated, refund scheduled, journal queued. will update when payout clears.
